en.title: Tournament Result Types
en.excerpt: Understand the two result types in Archeris: system-generated (live scoring via mobile app) vs manual upload (static documents). Choose the right approach for your tournament.
en.content:
When you set up a tournament in Archeris, you have a critical choice to make about how results will be managed: through the system's automated scoring or through manual file uploads. This decision determines whether participants will see live leaderboards and bracket visualizations or static documents uploaded by your organization.

Diagram showing how result type affects tournament workflow:

Choose the result type that matches your tournament's workflow and needs. Once selected, the organizer dashboard will show different scoring and management tools.

1. System-Generated Results (Automated Scoring)

Use this if: You want to run qualification and/or elimination rounds using Archeris's scoring system, with real-time scorekeeping and automatic result calculation.

How System-Generated Works

  1. Setup Qualification Sessions: In the Qualification > Sessions menu, create sessions (waves) and configure the number of ends and arrows per end.
  2. Assign Categories: Specify which competition categories (divisions, age groups, gender) shoot in each session.
  3. Allocate Targets: Set which physical target butts are used for each session.
  4. Scorekeepers Enter Scores: During the event, scorekeepers use the mobile app to scan target barcodes and input arrow scores end-by-end in real time.
  5. Auto-Calculate Rankings: Archeris automatically aggregates scores (total, 10s count, X-count) to generate official qualification leaderboards.
  6. Setup Elimination (Optional): For tournaments with brackets, go to Elimination > Brackets and click Generate to automatically seed the elimination bracket from qualification rankings.
  7. Elimination Scoring: Scorekeepers continue entering match results via the mobile app.
  8. Publish Results: Once qualification is locked or elimination is complete, results appear automatically on the public tournament page with live leaderboards and bracket visualizations.

What Participants See

On the Results tab of the public tournament page:

  • Qualification Leaderboard: Interactive table showing rank, archer name, club, scores per end, totals, 10-count, X-count, with category filters and sorting.
  • Elimination Bracket: Visual bracket diagram showing seed positions, match results, and winner progression round-by-round.
  • Live Updates: Results update in real-time as scorekeepers input data (refreshable by viewers).

System-generated results are ideal for transparent, official tournaments where participants and spectators want to see live scoring as it happens.

2. Manual Upload Results (Static Documents)

Use this if: You used an external scoring system (iAnseo, legacy platform, or manual scoring), results were already concluded, or you only need participant registration with results as informational attachments.

How Manual Upload Works

  1. Create Tournament & Register Participants: Set up the tournament event and registration (using the Participant Management module). Participants register normally through the app.
  2. Prepare Result Files: Create your result documents externally (PDF, spreadsheet, images, etc.) — ranking lists, medal tallies, statistics, etc.
  3. Upload via Dashboard: In the organizer dashboard Hasil (Results) tab, use the file upload area to drag-and-drop or select your result files. Supported formats: PDF, JPEG, PNG. Max 10MB per file.
  4. Add Titles: Give each file a descriptive title (e.g., "Final Ranking PDF", "Medal Distribution", "Statistics Report").
  5. Publish: Save the tournament settings to publish the files to the public page.

What Participants See

On the Results tab of the public tournament page:

  • Result Cards (Grid Layout): Each uploaded file is shown as a card with the title, file type icon (PDF, image), and action buttons.
  • Preview & Download: Participants can preview PDF files inline (embedded viewer) or images, and download each file.
  • No Interactivity: Files are static — no filtering, sorting, or live updates.

Manual uploads are quick for past events or when you already have results from another platform — just upload and done. Use this when Archeris is handling registration only, not the scoring.

3. Choosing the Right Result Type

Aspect System-Generated Manual Upload
Best for... Live tournaments with scoring on-site Past events, external scoring, registration-only events
Scorekeeping Mobile app (barcode scanning, real-time input) Not used — results from external source
Result Display Live leaderboards, interactive brackets, real-time Static PDF/image cards, downloadable
Setup Complexity Requires qualification/elimination configuration Just upload files, minimal setup
Participant Experience Transparent, exciting, live updates Simple, static, archive-like

Decision Tree

Ask yourself:

  • Are you running scorekeeping during the tournament (right now)? → System-Generated
  • Did you use a different platform for scoring? → Manual Upload
  • Is this a past/concluded event? → Manual Upload
  • Do you want live leaderboards on the public page? → System-Generated
  • Do you just want to show results as PDF/images? → Manual Upload

When in doubt, default to System-Generated if you plan to run live scoring on the day — it gives participants and spectators a far richer experience.

4. Can You Change Result Type After Setup?

Yes. You can switch between system-generated and manual upload at any time by editing the tournament settings in the organizer dashboard. However, understand that:

  • Switching to Manual Upload: Any qualification/elimination data already entered will not be shown on the public page. Upload files will appear instead.
  • Switching to System-Generated: Any manually uploaded files are retained but hidden. If you set up qualification/elimination, system-generated results will be used instead.

It's best to decide early and stick with one approach for clarity.

id.title: Tipe Hasil Turnamen
id.excerpt: Pahami dua tipe hasil di Archeris: system-generated (live scoring via aplikasi mobile) vs manual upload (dokumen statis). Pilih pendekatan yang tepat untuk turnamen Anda.
id.content:
Saat membuat turnamen di Archeris, Anda punya pilihan krusial tentang bagaimana hasil akan dikelola: melalui sistem scoring otomatis atau melalui upload file manual. Keputusan ini menentukan apakah peserta akan melihat leaderboard live dan visualisasi bracket, atau dokumen statis yang diupload organisasi Anda.

1. Hasil System-Generated (Scoring Otomatis)

Gunakan jika: Anda ingin menjalankan babak kualifikasi dan/atau eliminasi menggunakan sistem scoring Archeris, dengan pencatatan skor real-time dan perhitungan hasil otomatis.

Cara System-Generated Bekerja

  1. Setup Sesi Kualifikasi: Di menu Qualification > Sessions, buat sesi (gelombang) dan atur jumlah rambahan serta anak panah per rambahan.

  2. Tetapkan Kategori: Tentukan divisi kompetisi (busur, usia, gender) mana yang menembak di setiap sesi.

  3. Alokasi Target: Tentukan bantalan target fisik mana yang digunakan untuk setiap sesi.

  4. Scorekeeper Input Skor: Saat event, scorekeeper gunakan aplikasi mobile untuk scan barcode target dan input nilai anak panah rambahan per rambahan secara live.

  5. Auto-Hitung Peringkat: Archeris otomatis agregasi skor (total, jumlah 10, jumlah X) untuk generate leaderboard kualifikasi resmi.

  6. Setup Eliminasi (Opsional): Untuk turnamen dengan bracket, buka menu Elimination > Brackets dan klik Generate untuk otomatis buat bracket seeding dari hasil kualifikasi.

  7. Scoring Eliminasi: Scorekeeper lanjutkan input hasil pertandingan via aplikasi mobile.

  8. Publikasikan Hasil: Setelah kualifikasi dikunci atau eliminasi selesai, hasil muncul otomatis di halaman publik turnamen dengan leaderboard live dan visualisasi bracket.

Yang Peserta Lihat

Di tab Hasil halaman publik turnamen:

  • Leaderboard Kualifikasi: Tabel interaktif dengan rank, nama pemanah, klub, skor per rambahan, total, jumlah 10, jumlah X, dengan filter kategori dan sorting.

  • Bracket Eliminasi: Diagram bracket visual menunjukkan posisi seeding, hasil pertandingan, dan progres pemenang tiap babak.

  • Update Live: Hasil terupdate real-time saat scorekeeper input data (bisa di-refresh viewer).

Hasil system-generated ideal untuk turnamen transparan dan resmi di mana peserta dan penonton ingin melihat scoring live saat berlangsung.

2. Hasil Manual Upload (Dokumen Statis)

Gunakan jika: Anda pakai platform scoring eksternal (iAnseo, sistem lama, atau scoring manual), hasil sudah selesai, atau Anda hanya butuh registrasi peserta dengan hasil sebagai lampiran informatif.

Cara Manual Upload Bekerja

  1. Buat Turnamen & Daftarkan Peserta: Setup event turnamen dan buka registrasi (menggunakan modul Participant Management). Peserta mendaftar normal via aplikasi.

  2. Siapkan File Hasil: Buat dokumen hasil eksternal (PDF, spreadsheet, gambar, dll) — daftar peringkat, tally medali, statistik, dll.

  3. Upload via Dashboard: Di dashboard organizer tab Hasil (Results), gunakan area upload untuk drag-drop atau pilih file hasil. Format didukung: PDF, JPEG, PNG. Maks 10MB per file.

  4. Beri Judul: Kasih judul deskriptif untuk setiap file (e.g., "Final Ranking PDF", "Distribusi Medali", "Laporan Statistik").

  5. Publikasikan: Simpan pengaturan turnamen untuk publikasikan file ke halaman publik.

Yang Peserta Lihat

Di tab Hasil halaman publik turnamen:

  • Kartu Hasil (Grid Layout): Setiap file upload ditampilkan sebagai kartu dengan judul, ikon tipe file (PDF, gambar), dan tombol aksi.

  • Preview & Download: Peserta bisa preview file PDF inline (embedded viewer) atau gambar, dan download setiap file.

  • Tidak Interaktif: File statis — tidak ada filter, sorting, atau update live.

Upload manual cepat untuk event lampau atau saat punya hasil dari platform lain — tinggal upload dan selesai. Pakai ini saat Archeris handle registrasi saja, bukan scoring.

3. Memilih Tipe Hasil yang Tepat

Aspek

System-Generated

Manual Upload

Cocok untuk...

Turnamen live dengan scoring on-site

Event lampau, scoring eksternal, event registrasi saja

Pencatatan Skor

Aplikasi mobile (scan barcode, input real-time)

Tidak digunakan — hasil dari sumber eksternal

Tampilan Hasil

Leaderboard live, bracket interaktif, real-time

Kartu PDF/gambar statis, downloadable

Kompleksitas Setup

Perlu konfigurasi kualifikasi/eliminasi

Cukup upload file, setup minimal

Pengalaman Peserta

Transparan, exciting, update live

Sederhana, statis, seperti arsip

Pohon Keputusan

Tanya diri sendiri:

  • Apakah sedang menjalankan pencatatan skor saat turnamen? → System-Generated

  • Apakah pake platform scoring berbeda? → Manual Upload

  • Apakah ini event lampau/selesai? → Manual Upload

  • Apakah ingin leaderboard live di halaman publik? → System-Generated

  • Apakah hanya perlu tampilkan hasil sebagai PDF/gambar? → Manual Upload

Jika masih ragu, pilih System-Generated jika Anda berencana menjalankan live scoring di hari pertandingan — pengalaman yang jauh lebih kaya bagi peserta dan penonton.

4. Bisa Ganti Tipe Hasil Setelah Setup?

Bisa. Anda bisa switch antara system-generated dan manual upload kapan saja dengan edit pengaturan turnamen di dashboard organizer. Tapi perlu dipahami bahwa:

  • Switch ke Manual Upload: Data kualifikasi/eliminasi yang sudah diinput tidak akan ditampilkan di halaman publik. File upload akan ditampilkan sebagai gantinya.

  • Switch ke System-Generated: File manual yang diupload tetap tersimpan tapi tersembunyi. Jika setup kualifikasi/eliminasi, hasil system-generated akan digunakan.

Sebaiknya tentukan di awal dan stick dengan satu pendekatan untuk kejelasan.
